description: One funding group of a registered Rest organization, and the Customer its credit invoices are billed to. A child of Rest Credit Organization; identity is the pair (parent, funding_group_id), never the display name — two organizations may have groups with the same name, and matching on the name would bill one church's group as another's.

fields.label: Funding Group Id
fields.description: The group's own id in its Rest deployment. Unique within the parent row, which is the scope that matters — ids are per-deployment.
The billing entity for this group. Credits belong to the group that pays for them, so the invoice names this Customer and not the organization's.
fields.label: Customer

name: Rest Credit Organization Group
